title: A Sovereign and Virtuous Body: The Competent Muslim Woman's Guide to Health in Thanawi's Bihishti Zewar (1905)
note: Peer-reviewed historical study of Bihishti Zewar, examining the book's advice on women's religious, practical, and health knowledge.
whyItMatters: Provides scholarly context for Bihishti Zewar and its treatment of women's religious and practical learning.
